blocks.text: Day 3 · City tour and Sugar Loaf tour (4 hours, English-speaking guide). From Praia Vermelha (Red Beach), a cable car takes you to Urca Hill and its wide viewpoint, then on to Sugar Loaf Mountain (Pão de Açúcar), with beautiful views of Rio, Copacabana Beach, the bay, the surrounding mountains, the islands, the Rio–Niterói Bridge and the statue of Christ. The tour continues to the historic centre of old Rio, with its ancient churches, monasteries, the city’s Cathedral and colonial-style buildings.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport and fly to Foz do Iguaçu.

Iguazu lies in a natural park on the border between Brazil and Argentina. It is one of the largest waterfall systems in the world, with 275 cascades plunging into gorges.

On arrival, meet your driver and transfer to the hotel.
